what: Live demo diagnosis and fix, 2026-09-29. Bench C922 webcam on the Orin NX (25 W), lab scene with 1-3 people, mostly one man seated at a table side-on with his legs partly hidden.
complaint: demo crashed; one person counted as several, flickering; ~17 FPS; a seated person labelled standing
caveat: Live lab scenes, not a controlled test: people moved between runs, so the 'after' counts are not on the identical scene as 'before'. Timing numbers are comparable; count stability is indicative.

before.harness: tmp diag_live.py: deployed models run frame by frame, no tracking (as in the old demo)
aerial_detector_false_boxes_seen_on: the seated man's head and torso as separate people
before.coco_pose_duplicate_example: the seated man as a whole-body box and an upper-body box, IoU ~0.66, under the 0.7 NMS threshold

camera.usb: USB 2.0 hub port (480 Mbit/s); modes MJPG 1920x1080@30, 1280x720@60
camera.exposure_dynamic_framerate: was 1 (camera slows down in dim light); 720p delivered 29.7 fps with it on, 41.7 with it off, 60 with it off and default buffers
camera.usb_dropout: dmesg 15:48:36 'usb 1-2.3: USB disconnect'; the camera came back as /dev/video1, the demo only knew /dev/video0
camera.two_copies_running: two launch_demo.sh processes were running at once, started 15:44:49 and 15:46:18

edge_person_arm_only.note: unreliable when only an arm is visible; the demo only asks about people whose torso is visible

whole_frame_896px.answer: 2 people: man sitting at a desk, person sitting on the right

fix.model: yolo26s-pose-384x640.engine (same COCO weights, 16:9 engine), deployed as slot pose_bench
fix.dependency: lap 0.5.13 installed into ~/raptor-venv (ByteTrack's assignment solver; the board has no internet, so the aarch64 wheel was copied from the laptop)

runs.setup: desktop launcher, 1080p, VLM check, 2-3 people moving
aerial mode on the camera, no VLM

posture_new_rule.bus.jpg standing people: 3 of 3 standing (knee 0.55-0.74 torso lengths below the hip)
posture_new_rule.seated man, 450-frame run: geometry sitting on most frames; VLM sitting 257 of 257

after.clean_exits: 7 of 7 quits (during VLM loading, mid-answer and idle) exited 0. The first version of the new demo aborted once on quit ('terminate called without an active exception', the VLM thread was mid-answer); it now waits for the answer, and hard-exits if the model is still loading
